abstract: A new anticancer drug, VP16-213 was studied in vitro to determine its effect upon 3H-thymidine uptake and the survival rate of choriocarcinoma cells in comparison with the effect of MTX and Act-D. Three human choriocarcinoma cell lines, BeWo, HCCM-5 and SCH were used. The results were as follows; Serum VP16-213 levels were 10.3 +/- 1.19 micrograms/ml and 1.35 +/- 0.38 micrograms/ml at one hour and 12 hours after the administration of 100mg of VP16-213, respectively. In those three cell lines, VP16-213 suppressed cellular 3H-thymidine uptake by 70% as compared with the control. On the sixth day after exposure to VP16-213, the survival rate of choriocarcinoma cells was less than 10% in each of the three cell lines. One of the most prominent pharmacodynamic characteristics of VP16-213 was a rapid influx and efflux mechanism as seen in MTX. From the above, the anticancer effect of VP16-213 upon those three cell lines was supposed to be equal to or more than those of MTX and Act-D.
abstract_ja: 新規抗癌剤VP16-213について、3H-チミジン取り込みおよび絨毛癌細胞の生存率に対する効果を、メトトレキサート(MTX)およびアクチノマイシンD(Act-D)と比較してin vitroで検討した。ヒト絨毛癌細胞株BeWo、HCCM-5、SCHの3株を用いた。結果は次のとおりであった。VP16-213 100 mgを投与後、1時間および12時間の血清中VP16-213濃度はそれぞれ10.3±1.19 μg/mlおよび1.35±0.38 μg/mlであった。3細胞株すべてにおいて、VP16-213はコントロールと比較して細胞の3H-チミジン取り込みを70%抑制した。VP16-213曝露後6日目に、絨毛癌細胞の生存率は3細胞株いずれも10%未満であった。VP16-213の最も顕著な薬力学的特徴の一つは、MTXと同様の急速な流入・流出機構であった。以上より、3細胞株に対するVP16-213の抗腫瘍効果はMTXおよびAct-Dと同等かそれ以上と考えられた。
